cues: The central fringe is always bright, because the path difference there is zero for every wavelength.
The n th dark fringe sits at n minus a half, times beta, not n beta.
And inside a medium, always use lambda over n.
text: Three quick exam habits. The central fringe is always bright, because the path difference there is zero for every wavelength. The n th dark fringe sits at n minus a half, times beta, not n beta. And inside a medium, always use lambda over n.
